steps.name: Shadow Walker (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Geis] in 「Burning City」, then find [Iris] in 「Frozen World」.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You could have walked right past me. If you came to see me, you must have sensed something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. I just felt as though I should speak to you, Geis...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There is no need to puzzle over it alone. She has guided it all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She...?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The one who has become everything to you on your journey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The goddess is waiting. Go now, to the Frozen World...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's heart...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. Go to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll see you next time.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Oh, you're here. What brings you? You rarely come this far inside.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: %s has entered the Frozen World, then.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The goddess called.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: May we tell them?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: An heir of Carion has every right to know.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I still think it may be too soon...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As ever, you and I disagree. Just as we did when you received that necklace from Lady Leda...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Ah, the necklace...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Let us hope the necklace's choice does not bring misfortune.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes...

steps.name: Shadow Walker (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] in "Divine Tree Lapier" and obtain a <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Iris] in "Frozen World".

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You've arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... I heard you called for me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you remember when your journey began?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I arrived in Belos and read your memories at a stone monument.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, before that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I... I was in Lumen...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris reaches out and touches your forehead. A moment later, warmth spreads through your body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you starting to remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A different memory from what happened in Xenadia...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was... What I mean is...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, heir to the House of Count Carion... The Order of Deimos attacked, and your family's lands fell into their hands.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The count fought the Order to protect you, his heir. Then he entrusted you to Ull, Lord Ziskad's disciple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. On the night everything I had fell apart, Ull helped me escape to Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I tried endlessly to grow stronger, but it wasn't easy. So I asked Lord Ziskad to take me as his disciple, but he refused.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, on Ull's advice, I set out on a journey...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Why had I forgotten all this? Did I lose my memory?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. It's not that you have recovered lost memories. Something was simply preventing everyone from remembering.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's why I called you. Both you and I need to understand it, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It isn't difficult. Would you find an Illusion Seed in Gaia's dwelling and bring it to me? It is different from the Illusion Tree Seed that Tractus carries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've been waiting. So this is the Illusion Seed... Gaia also hopes it will help you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia does? How do you know, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Since inheriting the celestial deity's power from Seres, I've come to understand certain things.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's why I want to tell you. Little by little, I want to step forward and face you, %s. Now, look...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (The Illusion Seed melts away in Iris's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think I understand now. The power you were given was holding you back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The only power I have is something like a divine blessing...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Try to remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: O-okay...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You close your eyes and wait a moment. Unfamiliar images begin to surface.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Can you see them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss... Weiss wants something. Wait, I have the power he's after?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of House Carion... That's why the Order of Deimos came after me and everyone else...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, explain. What is this...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: House Carion possessed a power that cannot easily be put into words. Perhaps Weiss needed it. So, as he always does...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Please keep going. Don't stop...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It seems the Twisted Ones who stayed in Eastland long ago left an influence on certain people. A kind of power.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It may not be a Champion's power, but it has passed down through the heirs of House Carion for generations. In the very form Weiss desires...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like a binding?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps he wanted it to complete that... But now, he no longer remembers. The power has protected you so that you can become a true Chaser, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The blessings of Seres and Gaia, the traces of power I received through the Champions, and the power of Carion within you all reacted together, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: To shield you from the influence of the world's powerful beings... Weiss in particular...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Right now, Weiss does not realize that the person standing before him is the heir to House Carion.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wish it had only protected you from Weiss, %s, but it also affected the people you knew in Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so that's what happened. They didn't feel like strangers...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're welcome. But I'm not the one you should thank. That would be Lord Ziskad...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does the Sword Master already know...?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you get the chance, speak with him yourself. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh! %s, Yuran is looking for you. Would you go see him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking for me? Hmm, I wonder why... Iris, let's meet properly someday, when things are better. I'll look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes... See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were looking for me.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I was going to look for you, %s, but I hadn't told anyone. You've been to the Illusory World, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's nothing serious. My master asked me to arrange a meeting. I'll step aside for a moment so you can speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll wait a little.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Over here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it's a pleasure to meet you...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: A pleasure, heir of Carion... Thank you for holding on all this time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: After today's meeting, I may treat you as someone I've never met again. You know why, so let me ask your understanding in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The goddess Iris has probably told you something of it...? I should have paid closer attention to the Carion estate. I'm sorry I failed to do so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't apologize.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ull led a force in and brought you and a few other survivors out. That was the best we could do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for saving us.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Tell Ull that, rather than me. Ull truly cared about you...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: In any case...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thinking back on that time weighs heavily on me. When the estate fell, it reminded me of what happened to my homeland...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm truly grateful that you've persevered. I also commend you for no longer being consumed by the pursuit of power.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The person who once rushed in and demanded to become my disciple is gone. I'm glad to see you reborn as a follower of the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That is what I came to say. Thank you. I will continue to count on you. Many more difficult trials lie ahead...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I should return now. Don't be disheartened if I cannot remember you. And when all of this is over, come see me again.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Perhaps by then, I will be able to remember...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Well, I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be on my way as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Power of Carion, thank you... You cut me off from everyone to keep me safe...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Yes. Even if everyone else forgets, I remember. I'll hold on to these memories and keep following Iris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I won't tell people that they have forgotten me, or resent them for it.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: (Ziskad watches %s leave the union headquarters.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes. Follow your own path...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master, when did you arrive? I thought you would be back later this time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, Yuran. I had something to do, so I returned early. Has all been well?
